comparison_note: The 100-epoch animation study and the submitted 50-epoch broad comparison are distinct experiments. The page labels them separately and never substitutes a literature capability mark for an empirical result.
evaluation: H=100 open-loop rollout; dataset seed 42; five model seeds; illustrative trajectory uses model seed 42.
information_contract: Every model receives the same K=10 position history and coordinate-domain chart. No model receives velocity, momentum, simulator phase state, or supplied V/M/D/G components.

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: All seven models receive the same q-history. The synchronized animation and five-seed scores compare their open-loop predictions directly.
mechanism_evidence.label: Compare models
mechanism_evidence.question: Which model remains accurate after the position-history window ends?
mechanism_evidence.title: Forecast the same held-out trajectory

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: HNN is conservative. The matched pHNN adds a PSD damping channel. PHAST adds typed potential, mass, and damping channels plus its split transition. This isolates the value of representing loss at the family level, but it is not a one-switch PHAST ablation.
mechanism_evidence.label: Represent loss
mechanism_evidence.question: What changes when the phase-space model can represent PSD dissipation?
mechanism_evidence.title: Remove or restore irreversible loss

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: The continuous-time passivity statement follows from PSD damping. The plotted native energy is a finite-step diagnostic on one held-out trajectory; it is not a stronger discrete-time theorem, and raw energy scales are not compared across models.
mechanism_evidence.label: Track energy
mechanism_evidence.question: Does the learned structured rollout conserve or dissipate its own Hamiltonian?
mechanism_evidence.title: Inspect each model's native energy ledger

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: On the modal-damped LJ-3 benchmark, adding the PSD/modal anchor and dissipated-power loss reduces both rollout error and modal-power error. The gallery checkpoint itself is unbounded, so these numbers are shown separately rather than attached to its animation.
mechanism_evidence.label: Bound damping
mechanism_evidence.question: Does an ordered, anchored damping spectrum improve physical attribution?
mechanism_evidence.title: Constrain which modes can absorb error

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: In the separate Energy-Casimir pendulum study with q and p observed, the controller changes only how velocity is obtained. The PHAST port output reaches the same success rate as oracle velocity with lower mean control effort.
mechanism_evidence.label: Use the port
mechanism_evidence.question: Is PHAST's exposed port output accurate enough for passivity-based control?
mechanism_evidence.title: Use the learned Hamiltonian in feedback

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: The paper benchmarks Householder damping application and Woodbury mass solves and observes near-linear CPU scaling in dimension at fixed rank r=2. This is a primitive microbenchmark, not an end-to-end runtime comparison against the animated baselines.
mechanism_evidence.label: Scale primitives
mechanism_evidence.question: Do PHAST's structured damping and mass operations scale as intended?
mechanism_evidence.title: Exploit low-rank physical operators
